answer: Prove personhood by presence. Each epoch holds a ceremony: applicants share one two-minute window, solving human-only puzzles before random peer witnesses. One body cannot attend two ceremonies at once, so each extra identity needs another live person plus a 200 POA deposit, slashed on a failed check. An ember must be tended in person, not scripted; juniper witnesses reshuffle each epoch, and approving a fake forfeits deposits. The oasis stays open: deposits return after a clean epoch, but farming costs a wage plus a deposit per fake, every round. Limit: the offline wait until next epoch.
